lines.text: Once more it is {winner}, and by now the rest of the room knows the feeling!
{winner} just keeps winning, and {loserClub} are running out of ways to ask why!
Season after season, the name on top does not change, and the name is {winner}!
This is no hot streak any more, it is a habit, and the habit belongs to {winner}.
Nobody has found an answer to {winnerClub}, and the search has gone on a long, long time.
How long can {loser} keep chasing this shadow? {winner} walks on, and the run goes on!
Another season, another win, and {winnerClub} make the run look wonderfully easy.
You could set a clock by {winner} now. The season ends, and the winner is the same.
{loserClub} had a plan for this one, and {winnerClub} simply carried on regardless.
The run rolls on! {winner} wins again, and the weight on {loser} just got heavier.
Call it a streak, a spell, a stranglehold. {winner} just calls it normal.
Win once and it is a story. Keep winning like this, and it is a legacy, {winner}!
Season {season}, and nothing has changed at the top: {winnerClub} in front, everyone else looking up!
By {margin} this time, and it never felt in doubt. {winner} marches on!
{winner} by {margin}, and the streak lives to fight another day.
Remember when this Showdown felt wide open? {winnerClub} have politely closed the door.
Same name on the winner's line again, and {loser} can only shake a head and smile.
There goes the snowball, and it is picking up speed! {winner} rolls on downhill.
That is the sound of a streak being kept. {winnerClub} win again, and the run is alive and well.
{winner} has made winning a routine, and routines are hard to break. Just ask {loser}.
What a stretch this is for {winnerClub}! Win upon win, and no end in sight.
Hold the front page. No, keep it exactly as it was, because {winner} has won again!
The rest can only watch {winnerClub} glide away, season after season.
{loser} did everything right and still the answer came back the same: {winner}.
A run like this does not happen by accident. {winnerClub} have earned every step of it.
The streak is alive! {winner} adds another season to a story that keeps growing!
It is becoming a tradition, {winner}. The top seat has your name carved into it.
{winnerPoints} to {loserPoints}, and the run goes on. Nobody is catching {winner} right now.
They say form is temporary. Somebody forgot to tell {winner}!
Whatever the season throws up, {winner} answers it. Another win, another step clear!
On and on goes {winnerClub}, and {loserClub} are still waiting for the wheel to turn.
How many ways can you say it? {winner} wins, and wins, and keeps on winning!
Steady, relentless, almost polite. {winnerClub} keep collecting seasons like they are free.
{loser} gets back up, {loser} comes again, and still {winner} is standing at the end.
Now that is a regular! Same seat, same smile, same winner: {winner}.
It is a long, unbroken line of results, and {winnerClub} are the ones drawing it.
When the dust settles, one name remains. It has remained a good while now: {winner}.
{winnerClub} on top again, and the view from up there suits them.
What more can you say about {winner}? The run just does not stop!
Another one for {winner}, and the questions for {loser} grow louder by the season.
It is not luck anymore, it is a pattern. And the pattern wears the colors of {winnerClub}.
Hands up if you saw anyone stopping {winner}. Anyone? The streak goes on.
Fresh season, same story. {winner} writes the ending, and {loser} must wait for the next page.
{winnerClub} have turned winning into a way of life, and the rest are just visiting.
The big question hangs over {loserClub} once again: who stops this? Not today. {winner} wins on!
Steady as a drumbeat, {winner} wins another, and the rhythm will not break.
{margin} ahead, and {winner} never even raised a sweat. The run rolls on.
The champion's walk is getting well worn: same tunnel, same smile, {winner}.
They keep moving the target, and {winnerClub} keep hitting it.
Pressure? What pressure? {winner} wins again, and the run stays gloriously alive!
Nobody gets this far by accident. {winner} has built something special here.
Seasons come and seasons go, and one thing stays the same: {winnerClub} win.
You have to feel for {loser}. So close to turning it round, and so far from it.
{winner} has found a way again, and finding a way is what streaks are made of.
Lock it in: {winnerClub} take another season, and the run reaches yet another chapter.
Is there a crack in {winnerClub}? Not this season. Not a chance. The run stays alive!
There is no panic at {winnerClub}, only a calm, steady rhythm of winning.
Take a bow, {winner}. Season {season} and you are still the one they all have to catch.
Around the table they will talk about this run for years, and {winner} is the reason.
{loserClub} came with hope. {winnerClub} sent them home with another season to think about.
Some runs fade out. This one is getting louder, and {winner} is conducting it!
It has become a very long shadow, and it falls across {loserClub} once again.
The question every season is the same, and so is the answer: {winner}!
Round and round it goes, and every time the music stops, {winner} has the chair!
Another notch on the belt for {winner}, and the belt is getting crowded.
There is a calm confidence about {winnerClub} now. They expect to win, and then they win.
It is a magnificent run, and {loser} deserves credit for making {winner} work for it.
{winner} wins again and the cabinet door will not close. Not that anyone is complaining!
Pull up a chair, because this could go on. {winnerClub} are not done.
Well, it happened again. {winner} gets over the line and the run rolls into another season.
Whisper it, if you like: this is one of the great runs of the rivalry. {winnerClub}, again.
They tried to stop {winnerClub}, and they failed. They will try again, and they might fail again.
Nothing about this run looks fragile. {winner} wins again, and by {margin}.
Season {season} belongs to {winnerClub}, and the seasons before it tell the very same story.
Is this a dynasty? Ask {loser}, and then watch the face. {winner} wins again.
Lovely, steady, relentless winning from {winnerClub}. A run to be proud of.
And so the streak survives. It has survived a lot, and it has survived {loserClub}.
You wait for the slip, you wait for the stumble, and {winner} never gives you one!
Every season a fresh challenge, every season the same result: {winner} on top.
{winner} can feel it now, a whole run of wins behind them, carrying them forward!
It is the kind of run that makes people stop and say it out loud: {winner}, again.
{winnerPoints} points on the board, and another season banked for {winner}.
Never mind catching up. {loser} first has to slow {winner} down, and nobody has managed that.
The comfort of winning is a powerful thing, and {winnerClub} are swimming in it.
Look who is on top again. Surprise nobody: {winner}.
Is anyone going to stand in the way of {winnerClub}? Not this season, not today!
That is a masterclass in staying on top, and {winner} is the one giving the lesson.
The streak stays whole, {winner}. The only question left is how far it can stretch.
{loser} gave it everything, and {winner} had just a little more. Again.
Nothing is certain in a long Showdown, except this: {winnerClub} keep finding a way.
Here comes {loserClub}, fresh and hungry, and there goes another season to {winnerClub}!
It never gets old for {winner}, and it never gets any easier for {loser}.
They are queuing up to stop {winnerClub}, and the line just keeps getting longer.
One more for the pile, and what a pile it is! {winner} extends the run again!
Quiet, steady, deadly. That is how {winnerClub} keep doing it, season after season.
Do not call it luck. Luck runs out, and {winner} has not run out of anything.
This run has legs, this run has heart, and this run has {winner} written all over it!
Season {season} done, and the picture on the wall barely needs changing. It is {winner} again.
And the run goes on. {winnerClub} win again, and the chasing pack must start over.
Look at {winner} now, wearing the look of a manager who has done it all before. They have!
